reported_state: Candidate reconciliation separates the source selected-action quotient (A) from its flat detector tangent (B). The Lean source-convention adapter supplies a finite matrix witness for B, maps the source frame by right multiplication with eta into the existing solder Gram carrier, retains the quadratic remainder, and proves the full matrix-variable Fréchet derivative at the flat frame. The derivative composes with the finite solder readout over arbitrary LocalCoframeField N perturbations and is then collected into one Fréchet derivative for the entire output field x ↦ solderMetricMatrix N e x. Its value at each site is exactly the existing coframeMetricReadout. The matrix derivatives use the Frobenius norm and the full input/output fields use inherited finite Pi norms. No result connects A selected-action quotient to that Lean carrier, establishes global connection elimination or physical metric/source selection, or grants independent C0 acceptance.
